title: 第25章 天下公敌第26章 武德就是个屁
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
“天剑宗，今天你们最好给大伙一个交代。”
段则然双目赤红，心中怒气翻涌。
其他宗弟子同样义愤填膺，为了这只还没破壳的小真灵，死了这么多人，谁会甘心？
肖鹤本来就憋着一口气，看见这些人还在纠缠不休，他彻底怒了，“够了，还在没完没了是吗？”
“历练向来是宝物谁抢到就是谁的，同在没了就是没了，难道诸位想灭了我们天剑宗所有弟子，想引发宗门大战吗？”
“既然如此，我们奉陪。”
说着，肖鹤拿出宗门玉牌，“诸位，既然如此，那就叫上宗门长辈，大家不死不休。”
看到肖鹤动真格了，所有人才不得不咽下这口气。
其实大家都知道这个理，但就是不甘心，毕竟真灵太罕见了！
此时，天色渐渐暗了下来，森林里黑色雾气越来越浓郁。
山风渐起，呜呜声像无数冤魂在哭泣，远处更是传来阵阵妖兽的吼叫声，听得人头皮发麻。
这么多年，几乎没有修士敢在森林里过夜。
“出去吧。”
所有人不得不接受真灵蛋碎了的事实，不甘心地走出森林。
太初圣图里，云星落拍拍胸脯长松了一口气，终于是结束了。
在所有人离开之后，她贴上好几张逃遁符，如风一般逃出森林。
云星落到镇子上的时候，其他修士还没有出来。
广场上停着好几艘拉客的飞舟，一个穿着粗布衣服的中年人见她过来，立刻上前搭话，“坐飞舟吗，最后一趟了，还有一刻钟出发，再不走我们就走了。”
“能包飞舟吗？我想一个人坐。”
云星落想赶紧离开了。

这一次所有好处都被她一个人拿了，那些修士损失惨重，如果他们知道宝物都在她这里，那不得撕了她。
最关键的是，她的身上有黑衣少年的气息，如果黑袍人追过来，她连逃命的机会都没有。
中年人看了云星落一眼，不过十四五岁年纪，筑基修为，这样的小姑娘要包下一整艘飞舟？
他咧嘴一笑，“小姑娘，你可知道包一艘飞舟需要多少钱吗？我们这艘飞舟可乘坐五百人，就算最近的云隐镇一个人也要一千块。
你包一艘飞舟，最少也得五十万块下品灵石。”
“五十万而已，我出了。”
云星落没有犹豫，钱虽然重要，但是没有命重要。
说罢，她从乾坤袋中取出一个小袋子，放到中年人手中，“这是五十万，到云隐镇，越快越好。”
中年人接过袋子，打开一看，里面全是亮晶晶的下品灵石，顿时笑得眼睛都眯了，“好嘞！
姑娘稍等，我们现在就出发！”
要知道，飞舟每次不一定都能坐满，这次就拉一个人，却能拿到满额的钱，他们当然乐意了。
飞舟瞬间启动，发出一阵轰鸣声，光芒一闪，带着云星落消失在了寻仙镇的上空。
就在云星落离开不到一刻钟时间，所有修士回到了镇子上。
几个要去云隐镇的修士一看，广场上的飞舟没了，顿时懵了，“去云隐镇的飞舟呢，怎么没了？”
这时旁边有人搭话，“刚才被一个小姑娘包走了。”
“一个人包下一艘飞舟，这么有钱？”
众散修惊呼。
要知道，坐飞舟的大多是散修，散修本来就缺钱，能一个人包飞舟的，要么是背景硬，要么是实力强，肯定不简单。
“是什么样的小姑娘？”
这么有钱的散修，他们也想知道。

“一个穿淡绿色罗裙的小姑娘，扛着一把生锈的破剑。”
“云星落。”
苏芫芫第一时间就脱口而出，这个贱人，竟然还活着，而且竟然这么快走了？
content_en:
"Tianjian Sect, you'd better give everyone an explanation today."
Duan Zeran's eyes were red and anger surged in his heart.
The other sect disciples were also filled with righteous indignation. Who would be willing to die so many people for this little true spirit that had not yet broken out of its shell?
Xiao He was holding his breath, but when he saw these people still pestering him, he became completely angry, "That's enough, it's not over yet, is it?"
"Experience has always meant that whoever grabs the treasure belongs to the same person, and if it is gone, it is gone. Do you want to destroy all the disciples of our Tianjian Sect and trigger a sect war?"
"In that case, we will accompany you."
With that said, Xiao He took out the jade plaque of the sect and said, "Everyone, if this is the case, then call the elders of the sect and we will fight until death."
Seeing that Xiao He was serious, everyone had to take a breath.
In fact, everyone knows this truth, but they just don’t want to accept it. After all, true spirits are too rare!
At this time, the sky was getting darker and the black mist in the forest was getting thicker and thicker.
The mountain wind gradually picked up, and the whining sound was like countless innocent souls crying. In the distance, there were even roars of monster beasts, which made people's scalp numb.
For so many years, few monks dared to spend the night in the forest.
"Get out."
Everyone had to accept the fact that the true spirit egg was broken and walked out of the forest unwillingly.
In the Holy Picture of Taichu, Yun Xingluo patted his chest and breathed a sigh of relief, it was finally over.
After everyone left, she put on several escape charms and escaped from the forest like the wind.
When the cloud star fell on the town, the other monks had not yet come out.
There were several flying boats soliciting passengers parked in the square. When a middle-aged man in coarse clothes saw her coming, he immediately came up to talk to her, "Are you taking the flying boat? It's the last trip. We leave in a quarter of an hour. If you don't leave, we'll leave."
"Can you book a flying boat? I want to ride alone."
Yun Xingluo wanted to leave quickly.
This time all the benefits were taken by her alone, and the monks suffered heavy losses. If they knew that all the treasures were with her, they would not tear her apart.
The most important thing is that she has the aura of the young man in black. If the man in black comes after her, she won't even have a chance to escape.
The middle-aged man glanced at Yun Xingluo. He was only fourteen or fifteen years old and had a basic cultivation level. How could such a little girl charter an entire spaceship?
He grinned, "Little girl, do you know how much it costs to charter a flying boat? Our flying boat can carry five hundred people, and even the nearest Yunyin Town costs one thousand yuan per person.
To charter a flying boat, you will need at least 500,000 low-grade spiritual stones. "
"It's only five hundred thousand, I'm out."
Yun Xingluo did not hesitate. Although money was important, it was not as important as life.
After that, she took out a small bag from the Qiankun Bag and put it in the middle-aged man's hand, "This is five hundred thousand. The sooner we get to Yunyin Town, the better."
The middle-aged man took the bag and opened it. It was full of shiny low-grade spiritual stones. He smiled so hard that his eyes narrowed, "Okay!
Girl, wait a minute, we're leaving now! "
You know, Feizhou may not be able to fill up every time. This time, just one person can get the full amount of money. Of course they are happy.
The flying boat started up instantly, made a roar, and with a flash of light, it disappeared over Xunxian Town with Yun Xingluo.
Less than a quarter of an hour after Yun Xingluo left, all the monks returned to the town.
Several monks who were going to Yunyin Town saw that the flying boat in the square was gone, and they were stunned. "Where is the flying boat going to Yunyin Town? Why is it gone?"
At this time, someone next to me said, "I was taken over by a little girl just now."
"You can charter a spaceship by yourself and be so rich?"
All the cultivators exclaimed.
You must know that most of the people who ride flying boats are casual cultivators. Rural cultivators are inherently short of money. Those who can manage flying boats by themselves must either have a strong background or have strong strength. It is definitely not easy.
"What kind of little girl is she?"
They also want to know about such a wealthy casual cultivator.
"One wears light greenThe little girl in a seluo skirt was carrying a rusty broken sword. "
“The clouds and stars are falling. "
Su Xiangqian blurted out immediately, this bitch is still alive and left so quickly?
